A single large ancient leather-bound book lies closed on a carved olive-wood reading table, seen from a gentle low three-quarter angle, centred and sitting slightly above the middle of the frame. Its worn oxblood-red leather cover is embossed in raised gold lettering that reads exactly "THE HOLY BIBLE", with ornate gold corner pieces, a small golden lion emblem beneath the title and a crimson ribbon bookmark hanging out. Warm light from a brass oil lamp beside it; dust motes float in a soft beam of light; the background falls away into deep warm darkness with a faint arched window of stars. Quiet, reverent, expectant. The only text in the image is "THE HOLY BIBLE" on the cover.
Style: hand-painted epic storybook illustration matching the style reference exactly — rich painterly gouache-and-oil brushwork with visible strokes, fine dark ink linework on figures and edges, subtle parchment paper grain, warm golden-hour glow, honey gold, amber, ochre and crimson with lapis-blue accents, luminous sunlit clouds; the feel of an epic hand-drawn animated feature and a treasured children's Bible come to life. Cinematic 21:9 widescreen composition. No borders, no watermark, no captions.
Format: an ultra-wide letterboxed cinema frame. Solid pure-black bars fill the top 21% and the bottom 21% of the image edge to edge; the picture exists only in the 4:1 panoramic strip between them, and the whole subject, including its top and bottom edges, fits completely inside that strip with a little breathing room. Nothing crosses into the black bars.
